definitions.explanation: Having the form or pattern of waves; used to describe shapes, patterns, or phenomena that come in successive waves.

examples.japanese: {波状|はじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
{波状|はじょう}⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Wave after wave of attacks continued.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{波状|はじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れ→揺れ：16137_yure⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}された→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧。
examples.english: After the earthquake, undulating tremors repeated many times.

notes:
A compound of {波|は} (wave) and ⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧ (shape/form). Used both literally for physical wave-like shapes and figuratively for things that come in successive waves. The suffix ⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧ is productive and creates adjective-like nouns describing shape: {球状|きゅうじょう} (spherical), {帯状|おびじょう} (belt-shaped), {環状|かんじょう} (ring-shaped).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {波状|はじょう}⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧: wave attack; successive attacks in waves
- {波状|はじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧: wavy pattern
- {波状|はじょう}{雲|うん}: undulating clouds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{波形|はけい}→波形：27154_hakei⟧: waveform (more technical, referring to the shape of a signal or wave)
- {波打|なみう}つ: to undulate; to ripple (verb form)
- ⟦うねり→うねり：26821_uneri⟧: swell; undulation (more colloquial)
